snippet.title: Permafrost | The official gamescom Trailer
snippet.description:
Dive into a world dominated by constant sub-zero temperatures and battered by ice and snow. Experience, how an apocalyptic event brought humanity to its knees. 

Survive a brutal post-apocalyptic world buried in ice, where fractured factions, deadly storms, and collapsing remnants of civilization await. Will you endure the cold?

► Wishlist now on Steam:  https://bit.ly/WishlistPermafrost

About Toplitz Productions

Named after the mystic “Toplitz Lake” which is situated in a dense mountain forest high up in the Alps, Toplitz Productions was founded with the aim of developing and publishing computer and video games “with heart and soul”.
For more information, visit toplitz-productions.com.
